verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a community comment saying the vendor's page publishes a benchmark run on 5M records, and it notes the count(*) latency there was underwhelming. That confirms some published performance numbers exist, but no first-party benchmark docs, methodology, or recall figures appear in the pack. missing for 10: first-party benchmark documentation, vector recall numbers, latency percentiles (e.g. p99 for multi-hop queries), benchmark methodology and dataset scale details, independent reproduction.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/recall numbers backing the database's performance claims

citations.quote: page says your benchmark runs on 5M of records only.
